label: Nights spent in EU tourist accommodation, year to date
question: How big is European tourism in 2026?
answer: 1.80 billion nights were spent in EU tourist accommodation in 2026 through July, up 1.93% year on year.
sample: Dataset tour_occ_nim: nights spent at tourist accommodation, monthly
methodology: Eurostat dataset tour_occ_nim, nights spent at tourist accommodation, monthly, through July 2026. Official statistic subject to Eurostat's revision policy.
